scope: The expanded selection includes 24 SQL constant witnesses. Rust replaces all five top-level pruning transforms, and Java retains unused-table diagnostics. Constant propagation supports snapshot negation, literal and projected filters, direct scalar comparisons, identity, literal and single-column maps, and redundant incremental distinct. Other non-empty map and filter folds require additional scalar expression evaluation. The full scheduled compiler run precedes the added comparison case. The latest build rechecks the same-input pass graphs and runs the directed fixtures and detached SQL chains.
